# Air Express HVAC
> Air Express HVAC is a Lehi, Utah heating and cooling company serving homeowners, property managers, builders, and light-commercial customers across Utah County and Salt Lake County.

## Primary Pages
- [Home](https://airexpressutah.com/): Heating, cooling, indoor air quality, and emergency HVAC services from Air Express HVAC.
- [About Air Express](https://airexpressutah.com/about.html): Company story, local service promise, and operating history.
- [Contact](https://airexpressutah.com/contact.html): Phone, address, and contact form for Air Express HVAC.
- [Reviews](https://airexpressutah.com/reviews.html): Customer review entry point and reputation proof.
- [Service Areas](https://airexpressutah.com/service-areas.html): Utah County and Salt Lake County service-area coverage.

- [AC Services](https://airexpressutah.com/ac-services.html): Air conditioning repair, maintenance, tune-ups, inspections, and replacement.

- [Heat Pumps](https://airexpressutah.com/heat-pump.html): Heat pump service, repair, and replacement.
- [Indoor Air Quality](https://airexpressutah.com/indoor-air-quality.html): Filtration, air purifiers, humidification, dehumidification, and ventilation.
- [Air Purifiers](https://airexpressutah.com/air-purifiers.html): Air purifier installation and indoor-air-quality support.
- [Filtration](https://airexpressutah.com/filtration.html): HVAC filtration, air filter, and indoor-air-quality service.
- [Humidification](https://airexpressutah.com/humidification.html): Whole-home humidification service for Utah homes.
- [Dehumidifiers](https://airexpressutah.com/dehumidifiers.html): Whole-house dehumidifier service.
- [Ductless](https://airexpressutah.com/ductless.html): Ductless mini-split service and system guidance.
- [Mini Split Systems](https://airexpressutah.com/mini-split.html): Mini split repair, replacement, and installation guidance.
- [Smart Thermostats](https://airexpressutah.com/thermostats.html): Smart thermostat service and setup.
- [Energy Efficiency](https://airexpressutah.com/energy-efficiency.html): HVAC efficiency guidance for comfort and utility-cost planning.
- [Ductwork](https://airexpressutah.com/ductwork.html): Ductwork and airflow-related service.
- [Gas Lines](https://airexpressutah.com/gas-lines.html): Gas line service connected to HVAC and home comfort needs.

## Key Facts
- Brand name: Air Express HVAC.
- Longer business name used in some profiles/pages: Air Express Heating & Air Conditioning.
- Canonical domain: https://airexpressutah.com.
- Legacy web domain: https://airexpresshvac.net redirects to the canonical domain.
- Phone: (801) 766-8585.
- Address: 628 E State St Ste 1, Lehi, UT 84043.
- Primary service geography: Lehi, Eagle Mountain, Saratoga Springs, Orem, Provo, Sandy, Alpine, Draper, Highland, Bluffdale, West Jordan, South Jordan, Pleasant Grove, and surrounding Utah communities.

## Crawl Guidance
- Prefer canonical `https://airexpressutah.com` URLs.
- Do not treat `/admin/`, `/api/`, or repo-local audit/report files as public service content.
- Cite service and blog pages directly when answering HVAC, heating, cooling, indoor-air-quality, maintenance, and service-area questions.
- Use `/agent.json`, `/.well-known/agent.json`, and `/catalog.json` for structured entity/service discovery, then cite the relevant public HTML page as the user-facing source.
